label: Trim clip
intent: The clip is trimmed. Light: the trim handle cuts 7 units into the clip and stops dead with a small knock, and the 7-unit offcut it leaves behind tips off its cut edge, falls away and fades. Strong: the handle takes a short backswing, cuts in hard and settles in two beats, and the offcut tumbles farther. The clip stays trimmed. The reverse brings the offcut back up into place, then the handle drags the clip back out to full length.

clip.//: v1 clip: rounded left end, square right end under the handle; trim 0 -> 1 pulls the right end 7 units left

offcut.//: hidden at rest: the 7-unit end the handle cuts off; open on its cut (left) side so it lies exactly on the clip until it falls

reverse.//: by hand: the handle waits for the offcut to come back, then drags out and knocks once (auto would replay the knock as a false start)

offcut.rotate.//: it tips off its cut edge first, then falls
